name.description: Name of the buyer submitting the sourcing inquiry.

company.description: Company name of the buyer, if provided.

destination_country.description: Destination country or target market for the goods.

product_category.description: Product category or sourcing area requested by the buyer.

estimated_quantity.description: Estimated order quantity, MOQ target, or expected order size.

message.description: Detailed sourcing request including specifications, quality needs, packaging, pricing target, and timeline.

page_source.description: Website page or section where the inquiry was submitted.

status.description: Internal follow-up status for the sourcing inquiry.

submitted_at.description: Timestamp when the inquiry was submitted.
